items.question: By what count and in what kind of womb-diagrams are certain beings held in a state of torment?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant groups.
Those groups are located within thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings situated there are found in a tormented state.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Whether the count applies to beings or to the diagrams remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
